svg.title: A sprint goal, and retrospective notes when it ends — SoftTrack web design mockup (#271)
svg.desc: A sprint has a name, a start and an end, and completing one records numbers and no words. A goal is written when the sprint is planned and shows above its board; completing asks whether it was met and for a retrospective in three sections; an action from it becomes a ticket; and past sprints list all of it.
svg.text: A sprint goal, and retrospective notes when it ends
· what the sprint was for, and what the team learned

svg.text: Done when a sprint has a goal shown under its name in the sidebar and above its board, completing a sprint asks whether the goal was met, partly met or missed and for a
retrospective that can be filled in later, an action from the retrospective becomes a ticket linked back to the sprint, past sprints list goal, outcome, numbers and notes, and the sprint
webhooks carry the goal and the outcome.
